# Did your 3PL bill what your contract says, for what you actually shipped?

> Check a 3PL invoice against your contract rate card and your own records. Flags rates above contract, duplicate lines, charges not in the rate card, minimum double billing and storage over average on-hand, totals the recoverable dollars and writes the dispute email. Free, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
